_about: Each line of a shell block in README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/ (not docs/testing/) that runs ai-trust. src/docs-examples.test.ts runs every "run" command with the built CLI against a local registry serving docs/demo/registry-fixture.json, in a fresh HOME, and fails unless it exits with "exit". The fixture answers "not found" for a package it has no answer for; "note" says where that sets the exit code. "cwd" is where it runs (an empty directory when absent). Each "noexec" line is not run, for the reason given. A cited line missing here, or an entry no doc cites, fails the test.

ai-trust audit package.json --scan-missi.note: The fixture has an answer for every dependency of docs/demo, so nothing is scanned.

ai-trust batch @modelcontextprotocol/ser.note: The fixture has no answer for @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres, so it is not found.

ai-trust batch my-server-a my-server-b -.note: Placeholder names: the fixture has no answer for either, so both are not found.

ai-trust batch react vue express lodash.note: The fixture has answers for express and chalk only, so react, vue and lodash are not found.
